target.title: fix(path): retain mise shims when MISE_DATA_DIR is blank
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where OpenClaw could omit the default mise shims directory from child-process PATH construction when MISE_DATA_DIR was set to whitespace.

## Why This Change Was Made

MISE_DATA_DIR is trimmed before selection, so a blank override behaves like an absent override and the existing home-directory default remains canonical.

## User Impact

Commands installed through mise remain discoverable when service environments contain a blank MISE_DATA_DIR value.

## Evidence

- Base behavior: the regression could not find the default home/.local/share/mise/shims entry and failed with index -1.
- Exact head caf618e7beddd04154ec14095857b84bee193abf: focused regression -> 1 passed, 20 skipped.
- Command: node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/path-env.test.ts -- -t uses-the-default-mise-data-directory
- The test calls ensureOpenClawCliOnPath with a real candidate directory model and verifies the canonical default shim path is appended after system directories.
- Targeted oxfmt check and git diff --check passed.




### Real Windows production proof

Ran the current PR head on Windows with MISE_DATA_DIR set to whitespace and a real temporary home containing the default .local/share/mise/shims directory.

Observed redacted output:

- production ensureOpenClawCliOnPath appended the default shim directory: true
- Windows where.exe resolved openclaw-proof.cmd from <temp-home>\.local\share\mise\shims
- Windows cmd.exe executed the command through the bootstrapped PATH
- real command output: OPENCLAW_MISE_LIVE
- the temporary home and shim were removed after verification

This demonstrates real filesystem discovery, PATH propagation, executable resolution, and child execution rather than only the virtual-filesystem regression test.
